title: SSR: An Efficient and Robust Framework for Learning with Unknown Label Noise

anchors.quote: Clean sample selection by balanced neighbouring voting
anchors.paraphrase_zh: SSR 先用特征空间 KNN 的类别平衡邻域投票衡量当前标签一致性，再以阈值选择可靠子集；另由参数分类器对高置信样本重标，两个职责被刻意分离。

anchors.quote: we conduct extensive experiments on two standard benchmarks with synthetic label noise, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 实验覆盖 CIFAR 合成闭集与混合开集噪声，以及 Clothing1M、WebVision、ANIMAL-10N 三类真实噪声数据，并提供选择机制和计算成本附录。

anchors.quote: Robustness to hyper-parameters In this section, we conduct extensive ablation studies
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 消融扫描选择阈值、重标阈值和邻居数，移除样本选择，比较类别平衡、NPK 与参数模型选择、特征一致性距离，并报告各阶段耗时。

LIMITATIONS.pages: 1-16 including conclusion and all supplementary sections
LIMITATIONS.absence_reason_zh: 全文没有独立局限章节，也未讨论测试集 Best 指标的选择偏差、各表训练种子数、KNN 邻域对来源聚类的敏感性以及动态选中样本的累计曝光。

formulas: The class-balanced neighborhood distribution is q_i = pi^{-1} q'_i, where q'_i is the normalized label histogram of K nearest feature neighbors.
Label consistency is c_i = q_i(l_i^r) / max_j q_i(j); c_i above theta_s admits the sample to the clean subset.
The parametric classifier relabels an example only when max_l p_i(l) exceeds theta_r.
Training minimizes cross-entropy on the selected subset plus optional cosine feature-consistency loss L = L_ce + lambda L_fc.
algorithm_steps: Extract current features for all samples and obtain a class-balanced KNN label distribution in feature space.
Use the current parametric classifier to relabel only high-confidence examples.
Select examples whose relabeled class agrees maximally with the balanced KNN vote; oversample minority classes within the selected set.
Train the encoder and classifier on selected examples with cross-entropy and optionally use every example for augmentation-based feature consistency; repeat from the first epoch without a warm-up.
variables: encoder f, parametric classifier g_p, and non-parametric KNN classifier g_q
K-neighbor set N_i and cosine similarity
class-balanced neighbor distribution q_i and consistency c_i
selection threshold theta_s and relabel threshold theta_r
selected clean subset X_c and progressively relabeled labels Y^r
selection_timing: Relabeling and selection are executed before model training in every outer iteration, including the first epoch; the authors intentionally avoid a fixed warm-up period.
refresh_rule: Features, KNN neighborhoods, relabeling decisions, and the clean subset are recomputed at every epoch as the encoder changes.

budget.unit: optimizer-visible selected examples used by cross-entropy in one epoch
budget.denominator: the full noisy training set; selection fraction is threshold-driven rather than fixed in advance
budget.unique_sample_definition: Membership is defined by sample identity and current c_i, but the paper does not publish the number or union of unique selected IDs across epochs.
budget.repeat_definition: A selected identity can remain selected and be oversampled in successive epochs; optional feature consistency also exposes all samples repeatedly.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: The paper does not tabulate cumulative supervised, oversampled, or feature-consistency exposures per identity, so method and baselines are not exposure-matched.
budget.compute_cost: Every epoch requires full feature extraction, KNN construction, relabeling, and selection; Table 9 reports these costs separately from gradient propagation.

random_baselines: cross-entropy on the whole noisy dataset
oracle clean subset as an upper baseline in Supplementary Table 7
PMC loss/confidence selection versus NPK feature-neighborhood selection in automatic and known-noise-ratio modes
No equal-count global-random or neighborhood-matched-random selector is reported.
checkpoint_selection: Several tables report both Best and Last test accuracy without an independent validation-only checkpoint rule; Last is the safer fixed-endpoint evidence, while Best has potential test-oracle bias.

results.claim: 在不知道噪声比例的自动模式下，NPK 邻域选择在 40% 非对称 CIFAR-10 上大幅优于参数分类器选择。
results.value: NPK automatic Last 88.20% versus PMC automatic Last 48.88% test accuracy.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 在其余训练组件被排除的选择机制对比中，NPK 自动选择的固定末轮在 40% 非对称噪声列为 88.20%，而 PMC 为 48.88%。

results.claim: 在 CIFAR-100 的 90% 对称噪声设置中，SSR+ 的表内准确率高于被比较方法。
results.value: SSR+ 66.6%; SSR 61.8%; C2D 58.7%; AugDesc 41.2% test accuracy.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 最重噪声列中 SSR+ 报告 66.6%，但论文没有给出训练种子方差，因此这只是特定设置的表内结果。

results.claim: 类别平衡对两类数据的增益为小幅正向，而非主要性能来源。
results.value: SSR versus without balancing: 74.83% vs 74.12% on Clothing1M and 95.5% vs 94.9% on CIFAR-10 asymmetric noise.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 移除两个平衡机制后分别下降 0.71 和 0.6 个百分点，说明选择与重标机制之外的平衡贡献存在但较小。

negative_results: Removing selection degrades severely at 90% symmetric noise.
Extremely small K is unstable in the neighbor-count ablation.
Relabeling becomes conservative when open-set noise is present, so selected-set growth is not uniform across noise types.
Best and Last values diverge sharply for some PMC and whole-dataset baselines, exposing memorization and checkpoint sensitivity.
No random-control or cross-seed stability evidence is supplied.
failure_conditions: Feature neighborhoods cluster by source, video, or nuisance rather than label reliability.
Early representation quality is insufficient for KNN voting despite the no-warm-up claim.
Repeated relabeling creates confirmation bias that the same encoder later reinforces.
Threshold-driven selected counts change optimizer-visible exposure and make method comparisons budget-unfair.
Best test checkpoints are used as evidence of deployable improvement.
limitations: The method jointly changes reliability selection, relabeling, class balancing, oversampling, and optional feature consistency.
Selection budget, unique IDs, repeat histograms, cumulative exposure, and optimizer steps are not matched or reported.
No equal-count global or method-matched random selector is tested.
Training seed counts, variability, and worst-seed results are absent.
Feature-neighborhood reliability is not source/video-disjointly validated.
The endpoint is overall multiclass test accuracy, not FN95 or a local safety-frontier metric.
stage1_mechanism_zh: 该论文为 Q 门控提供可迁移机制：当前 loss 或模型置信度在重噪声下会受记忆化影响，而来源分层后的特征邻域一致性可作为另一种可靠性候选；同时每轮刷新说明 Q 取决于模型状态。Stage1 只能将其作为 Q 的独立析因条件，并在来源或视频分组内计算，之后仍需 R、独立 FN95 方向 A 与集合覆盖 D 的顺序门控。
stage1_non_inference_zh: SSR 的表内提升不能证明 replay utility：它重写标签、改变监督池大小、过采样类别并可对全部数据施加特征一致性，累计曝光和 optimizer steps 与对照不匹配。没有 R1、R2、current-loss、no-replay 或未见 training seed 配对，因此不能把 NPK 一致性直接解释为应增加 replay 曝光的样本价值。
